selected_scope: raw_close and its necessary calendar/status/rules/rights dependencies only; otherOHLCV may be stored later only under declared scope
distinctions: first_project_received_at is a verifiable local receipt, not proof of global first publication
future first receipt cannot certify old2023/2024 versions
new revision append-only, never overwrite old decision snapshot
if only a date is known, use independently supported time bound or keep unknown; no guessed fixed lag
quality_rejections: missing daily status/rules or incomplete cost/right evidence for action use

no_market_or_prediction_promotion: Design or later collection alone does not open historical PIT, targets, forecasting, simulation or an observation-day clock
